Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

1. Scope — Covers the dimensions and requirements for side and face milling cutters with plain bore 
and key drive. 

2. Type — Shall be of the foltowing types : 

Type A — with staggered teeth ( double alternate helix ), and 
Type B — with straight teeth.

IS: 6308 -1982 

4. General Requirements 

4.1 Dimensions for keyways shall be according 1o IS : 6285-1971 ' Dimensions for interchangeably of 
milling cutters and milling arbors with key drive '. 

4.2 For requirements not covered in the standard, it shall conform to the requirements as given in 
IS : 1830-1982. 'Technical supply conditions for milling cutters ( second revision) '. 

5. Sampling — The sampling and criteria of acceptance shall be in accordance with IS : 7778-1975 
1 Methods for sampling small tools \ 

6. Designation — A side and face milling. cutter of Type A, having diameter D = 80 mm, width 
b a 14 mm for Tool type N, made from high speed steel and conforming to this standard shall be 
designated as: 

Side and Face Milling Cutter A 80 x 14 IS : 6308 

6.1 When the side and face milling cutter is required with tool type other than N, the tool type H or S, as 
appropriate shall be added immediately after the size. 

Example : 

Aside and face milling cutter of Type A, having diameter D « 80 mm width 6 = 14 mm of 
tool type H made from high speed steel and conforming to this standard, shall be 
designated as : 

Side and Face Milling Cutter A 80 x 14 H IS : 6308 

7. Certification Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard was first published in 1971. This revision is necessitated, so as to bring it in line 
with the work done at ISO level. 

In the preparation of this standard considerable assistance has been derived from : 

ISO 2587-1972 'Side and face milling cutters with plain bore and keydrive — Metric series '. 
International Organization for Standardization. 

DIN 885-1976 ' Scheibenf raser ' ( Side and face milling cutters ). Deutsches Institut fur Normung.

Reprography Unit, BIS, New Delhi, India
